messages.content:
You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Which of the following statements most accurately describes the findings and implications from the chest X-ray in Figure 3, considering the clinical context of Churg-Strauss syndrome and treatment history?

A) The chest X-ray in Figure 3 shows persistent nodular opacities, suggesting ineffective corticosteroid treatment.
B) The chest X-ray in Figure 3 shows complete resolution of pulmonary nodules, indicating effective corticosteroid treatment.
C) The chest X-ray in Figure 3 shows new onset pulmonary infiltrates, suggesting a complication unrelated to Churg-Strauss syndrome.
D) The chest X-ray in Figure 3 appears normal, supporting effective corticosteroid treatment and temporary disease remission.
E) The chest X-ray in Figure 3 shows cavitary lesions, indicating a possible secondary infection.
F) The chest X-ray in Figure 3 shows bilateral lung consolidation, suggestive of a severe asthma exacerbation.
